Results

What the first cohort reported

After four weeks, people in the first Safety Simplified cohort reported:

  • +53%How often they felt safeSafety stopped being a happy accident. By week 4, people were reaching for it on purpose, several times a week.
  • +74%How strongly they felt safeNot just feeling okay: the depth of safety nearly doubled.
  • +35%Confidence in their skills
  • −48%How often they shut down
  • −27%How often they froze up
  • +50%Healthy energy to move and act
240%

Does the practice matter? Yes. The average student reported 53% more moments of safety. Those who used the tools just twice a week reported 240% more.

Self-reported by the first cohort. Results vary.

You're tired of feeling unsafe in your own body

You've tried breathing exercises, meditation apps, and all the "feel your feelings" advice. But your nervous system didn't get the memo. You still feel tense, on guard, or numb and shut down. You're exhausted.

Safety Simplified is a 4-week, cohort-based program for people who know they're stuck in survival mode and are ready for a structured, gentle, simple, science-backed way to help their nervous system finally feel safe. If you're ready to connect with safety and grow real calm from the inside out, this is for you.

How it's different

Instead of exercises from a guru that sort of help for a little while and then get forgotten, you learn, practice, and master essential safety skills.

Gradual
Over 4 weeks, each week builds on the one before. Nothing is overwhelming or out of reach.
Practical
Every week has a short lesson on safety, live guided practice, and homework you can act on. You build new capacities into your daily life, not just learn theory.
Safety margins built in
Every skill comes with modifications, ways to scale it, and clear guidance on when to ease up. You learn to recognize how much you can handle and work within it, building room without overwhelm.
Community
You practice with others, so you benefit from connecting with people (co-regulation), a key ingredient for feeling safe, especially after trauma or a hard attachment history.
Expertise
Led by Justin, a member of the Polyvagal Institute Editorial Board. The curriculum is grounded in Polyvagal Theory and refined through hundreds of hours of clinical work and 8+ years of teaching nervous system regulation to thousands of students.

The skills you'll build

You don't need more theory, more gurus, or more influencer "advice." You need real skills. Over the four weeks, you'll learn, practice, and master:

  • Deeply connecting with what safety feels like in your body
  • Validating and normalizing safe feelings and experiences
  • Describing your inner experience of safety in depth
  • Creating safety around you
  • Mindfully connecting with safety around you
  • Checking how safe your body feels
  • Checking whether you're ready to welcome defense

Is it for you?

It's a good fit if:
  • You're tired of feeling unsafe in your own body and ready for a structured, gentle approach.
  • You want practical skills that build lasting safety, not just short relief through coping or distraction.
  • Safety is new to you, you want to deepen it, or you want to get back to basics.
  • You want a simple, direct approach grounded in Polyvagal Theory and nervous system science.
  • You want to master essential safety skills and stop relying on gurus, influencers, or the latest wellness trend.
Please don't join if:
  • You're looking for a quick fix or a hack.
  • You want to spend time with "parts," ego, shadows, and so on.
  • You're not willing to be an active member of a cohort.
  • You aren't willing to practice the skills between meetings.

Why it works

Safety is a skill you can learn, practice, and master, so your nervous system feels calmer, steadier, and more resilient.

Safety first

Each skill begins in safety, stays in safety, and ends in safety.

Gradual

Each skill builds on the last in small, sustainable steps.

Together

You practice with people who know what feeling unsafe is like. Connecting with the group helps your nervous system learn safety faster than going it alone.

Learnable

Built on Polyvagal principles and years of teaching. Safety is learnable, and this program is the roadmap.

Questions

What if it's too difficult?

Safety Simplified is a simple, gradual connection with safety that deepens over 4 weeks, designed for beginners. Nothing should be too difficult. If something is hard, please still come, and focus on the skills you can do.

Do I need to attend every week?

Yes. This is a cohort experience, and it's only as strong as the people in it, so regular attendance is required.

How soon will I see results?

It depends on many factors, so it's hard to say. People report feeling more connected to safety by week 1.

Is it recorded? Can I watch the replays?

Yes, meetings are recorded, and you can watch the replays of the meetings you attend. If you leave the cohort or miss a week, you won't get access to the other meetings. If your plan is to "someday" watch the replays, please don't sign up. The replays are a bonus to the live experience.

Does this replace therapy?

Definitely not. But it can be a great supplement to therapy. Please talk it over with your provider(s).

What happens after the 4 weeks?

Safety Simplified leads straight into the Self-Regulation Simplified cohort, so if you're ready for more advanced skills, you're welcome to join. You can also repeat Safety Simplified on its own. You keep the replays and the downloadable safety meditations to keep practicing. Co-Regulator members of the Unstucking Academy can join any and all cohorts as part of their membership.

More questions? I'm happy to answer them personally: justin@stucknotbroken.com.
